name: Product Strategy & Execution
title: The strategy round, drilled: business reasoning, prioritisation, and real execution.
lede: A mock focused on the strategy and execution round — 'should the company build X', 'how would you grow Y', 'you have limited resources, what ships first'. We run a realistic prompt, then I show you how to reason about business goals, prioritise under constraints, and defend an execution plan.
reassure: 100% money-back guarantee — if it isn't useful, tell me and I'll refund it in full.
forYou: Facing a product strategy or execution round soon
Strong on features but shaky on business reasoning
Struggling to prioritise cleanly under constraints
Unsure how to connect a product decision to company goals
Wanting to sound like a PM who can actually ship
notForYou: You want a product sense or metrics round (book those instead)
You haven't mapped which rounds you need (start with a strategy session)
You want written feedback, not a live mock

howItWorks.d: Checkout in your local currency and you'll be handed straight to booking.
Pick a slot and share your target role and level.
A realistic strategy prompt, timed, on Google Meet — you answer as if it's the real round.
We break down your answer and I show you how to reason about goals, prioritise, and defend execution.

deliverables: A structure for reasoning from company goals to a decision
A cleaner method for prioritising under real constraints
A way to defend an execution plan and its trade-offs
Honest feedback on where your reasoning got fuzzy
The specific fixes to practice before the real round

faq.a: Whether you can connect a product decision to the business — reason about goals and trade-offs, prioritise under constraints, and lay out an execution plan you can defend.

faq.q: How is this different from product sense?
faq.a: Product sense is user-and-design led; strategy is business-and-execution led. This round cares more about why the company should do something and how it actually gets shipped.

faq.q: Do I need startup or big-tech context?
faq.a: We'll tailor the prompt to your target companies. The reasoning structure works across both; only the context and constraints change.

finalCta.title: Reason like a PM who ships.
finalCta.sub: Book a focused mock and leave with a strategy structure that holds up.
